chunks: 2137 - Whoever prepares a mount for the hajj is like one who ties a horse in the way of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.

And it is said: so-and-so made hajj, meaning he attained success; and hajj is the قصد, the going to the House of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, to serve Him according to what has been commanded of completing the rites.

key_terms.بَيْتِ ٱللَّهِ: The House of Allah, the destination of hajj.
key_terms.حُجُّوا: Perform hajj; undertake the pilgrimage to the House of Allah.
key_terms.فَفِرُّوا: Hasten and turn away from all else toward Allah.
key_terms.فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ: In the way of Allah; for His cause.
key_terms.مَحْمِلًا: A mount or conveyance prepared for the journey of hajj.
key_terms.ٱلْحَجُّ: The pilgrimage to the House of Allah with the prescribed rites.
key_terms.ٱلْمَنَاسِكِ: The ritual acts and rites to be completed in hajj.

ai.seo_question: How is the verse "So flee to Allah" interpreted in relation to hajj?
ai.summary: This text explains the verse "So flee to Allah" as a directive toward hajj, presenting pilgrimage as a movement of turning to Allah. It also states the merit of preparing a mount for hajj and defines hajj as intending the House of Allah to fulfill the prescribed rites.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2137 - Whoever prepares a mount for the Hajj is like one who ties a horse in the way of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic.
